{{Quote|Although it is nearly impervious to a lightsaber blade, it is extremely heavy and requires the wearer to rely on a Strong style, or ''djem so'', combat stance.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="BoS" />}}
'''''Beskar'kandar''''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] comprised of plates forged from [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]],<ref name="BoS" /> a near-indestructable [[Ore/Legends|ore]] found only on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> The ''beskar'' used in the [[Armor/Legends|armor's]] construction made it almost impervious to the blows of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. However, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]—who wrote a brief passage on ''beskar'kandar'' armor in an essay entitled ''[[The Rule of Two]]''—found the armor to be extremely heavy, and noted that any [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who may consider utilizing the Mandalorian armor should adopt a [[Strong style|Strong]] or [[Form V/Legends|''Djem So'']] stance while in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is Mandalorian armor, made from beskar (Mandalorian iron). It is rare, cumbersome, and heavy.|[[Daniel Wallace]]|<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_30.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 3)}}</ref>}}
''Beskar'kandar'' was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2012]] reference book, ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Daniel Wallace]].
